The series

Three books, one very silly dino family

Each story is a 24 to 30 page square paperback for ages 3 to 8, made for reading out loud and laughing together.

Book 1

Count to Ten

In their very first book, five-year-old Alexis and her baby dinosaur friends spend an exciting day together while learning to count to ten.

Meet the gang

They wear diapers, they giggle a lot, and they are still learning how everything works.

Alexis

Five years old, big imagination, and best friend to two baby T-Rexes.

Snap

Alexis' orange baby T-Rex. He's a boy, and he's always ready to play.

Daisy

Alexis' blue baby T-Rex. She's a girl, and she never goes anywhere without her red bow.

Abigail

Alexis' best friend, who comes over to play in Hide and Seek.

Meet everyone

Play along

Can you count the T-Rexes?

Count the dinosaurs in the yard, then tap the matching number. A little game straight out of Count to Ten.

Little artists welcome

Love drawing dinosaurs too?

Kevin also makes step-by-step How to Draw books for kids. You'll find them, plus free drawing lessons, at FirstArtBooks.com.

Visit FirstArtBooks.com

For parents and teachers

Made for read-aloud time

Count out loud

Point to each dinosaur as you read and let your child say the number out loud. Then count something real together: toys, snacks or stairs.

Make a gift

After reading, make a gift together for someone you love: a drawing, a card or something built from blocks.

Play hide-and-seek

Hide a stuffed dinosaur somewhere in the house and take turns being the seeker, just like Alexis and Abigail.

Meet the author and illustrator

Kevin Coulston is a cartoonist and children's book author and illustrator. He wrote and drew all three Alexis and the T-Rexes books, and he has made more than 80 books for kids, including the How to Draw series from FirstArtBooks.
